column1: # libvirt lab guests — THE single place to edit sizes, addresses and MACs.
# Columns are whitespace separated (spaces or tabs). '#' starts a comment, blank lines are
# ignored, '-' means "not applicable". Parsed by scripts/lab/virt/lib.sh:load_guests().
#   name          kind    vcpu  mem_mib  disk_gib  mac_lab            ip_lab        mac_storage        ip_storage
# kind:     talos  -> boots the pinned Talos metal ISO, driven by talosctl (docs/runbooks/talos-bootstrap.md)
#           debian -> boots the Debian cloud image + cloud-init (NFS + SMB stand-in, NOT TrueNAS)
# mac_lab:  fixed so the homelab-lab network can reserve ip_lab by MAC (deterministic addressing)
# ip_lab:   docs/decisions.md §2.4 — 10.99.100.0/24, disjoint from the house LAN / server VLAN
# mac_storage/ip_storage: only the NAS is on the /30 storage link today; 10.99.101.1 is the
#           libvirt bridge (the lab's stand-in for the Proxmox end of that point-to-point link).
